title: How To Pray
paragraphs: This is how I pray. I got it from the Bible. First you startprayer with Thanksgiving. You never go into the courtroom of God demanding things first. You thank himfor what he's already done. Are you with me? So, I want you to start thanking God for the things that he's already done. Thenthe next step is you begin to declare his word. That's what he wants to hear. Then you express the promises that he made. That's your demands. And then you wait on him. He always wants meditation. Quietness.
And then you speak in tongues. Let the Holy Ghosthelp you pray. That's what I do. It works every time. Thanksgiving, declaration, expression of promises, quietness, and tongues. Petition.
